# Soft deleting an Exchange folder uses the same-server move path

Folder DeleteSelf uses the common delete-policy dispatcher. In the soft branch it asks the configured Trash folder to move this folder through CopyFolderOnSameServer; the hard branch removes the local folder only after the remote delete callback. The original policy checks the folder Trash flag, while accepted later code checks Trash ancestry and handles virtual folders locally. The new EWS test asserts no hard-delete record and the same mock folder ID under deleteditems. It does not assert message-content recovery, undo or a warning. The reused move comment describes observed EWS ID stability, not a provider or Graph guarantee. No deletion or UI test ran.

Scope: exchange-folder-deletion.
